qs.q: Why might the hiring program decide that male applicants are better?
qs.qko: 채용 프로그램은 왜 남성 지원자가 더 낫다고 판단할 수 있나요?
opts: Because the company mostly hired men in the records it learned from
Because the program was told to treat women unfairly
Because men answered the interview questions faster
evs: If the company mostly hired men during that period, the program may conclude that male applicants are better candidates.
The program is not trying to discriminate; it is simply copying the patterns it was given.
Diverse teams can also help notice problems that others might miss.
Artificial intelligence systems, however, learn by finding patterns in large amounts of data collected from the real world.
why: 본문에 회사가 그 기간에 주로 남성을 뽑았다면 프로그램이 남성 지원자가 더 낫다고 결론 낼 수 있다고 나와요. 프로그램은 차별하려는 게 아니라 데이터를 따라 할 뿐이에요.
The text says that if the company mostly hired men, the program may conclude men are better. It is copying its data, not trying to discriminate.

qs.q: In 'computers are objective,' what does 'objective' mean?
qs.qko: 'computers are objective' 에서 'objective' 는 무슨 뜻인가요?
evs: Many people believe that computers are objective because they follow mathematical rules rather than feelings.
The program is not trying to discriminate; it is simply copying the patterns it was given.
Suppose a company trains a hiring program using records of the employees it hired over the past twenty years.
Ignoring these steps can turn old human prejudices into automated decisions that affect millions of people.
why: 같은 문장에서 컴퓨터는 «감정(feelings)이 아니라 수학적 규칙» 을 따른다고 해요. 그래서 objective 는 «감정에 흔들리지 않는» 이라는 뜻이에요.
The same sentence says computers follow mathematical rules rather than feelings, so objective means not influenced by feelings.

qs.q: Why can AI bias become a serious problem for society?
qs.qko: 인공지능의 편향은 왜 사회에 심각한 문제가 될 수 있나요?
opts: It copies unfair patterns and can use them in decisions about millions of people
It makes computers break down more often
It stops companies from hiring anyone at all
evs: The program is not trying to discriminate; it is simply copying the patterns it was given.
Ignoring these steps can turn old human prejudices into automated decisions that affect millions of people.
Artificial intelligence systems, however, learn by finding patterns in large amounts of data collected from the real world.
Diverse teams can also help notice problems that others might miss.
why: 프로그램은 받은 패턴을 그대로 따라 하고, 그러면 옛 편견이 수백만 명에게 영향을 주는 자동 결정이 될 수 있어요. 두 단서를 합치면 답이 나와요.
The program copies the patterns it is given, and this can turn old prejudices into automated decisions affecting millions. Together these give the answer.
